Strong PowerShell skills for administration, automation, configuration and operational support. Experience supporting backup, recovery, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities for on-premises workloads. Ability to work within restricted or disconnected environments where internet access, cloud services and automated tooling may be limited. Ability to produce and maintain technical designs, build documents, as-built records, operational procedures, runbooks and support documentation. Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills, with the ability to explain risks, negotiate outcomes and provide clear technical recommendations. Ability to provide senior technical expertise to projects, security teams and business areas. A high level of professionalism, sound judgement and strong decision-making skills.
